plan.title: Explore data structure and annotations
plan.description: Write a script to examine: (1) number of images in data/train/images/, (2) structure of annotations.json (categories, annotations count, image sizes), (3) distribution of annotations per image, (4) category frequency distribution, (5) sample entries from metadata.json, (6) structure of data/products/ directory (how many products, what images exist). Also examine the existing train_split.json and val_split.json to understand if splits are already created.
plan.success_criteria: Clear understanding of data properties: image count, annotation count, category distribution, image dimensions, split sizes, product reference image availability

plan.title: Validate splits and check environment
plan.hypothesis: Need to confirm splits are valid and GPU/packages are available
plan.description: Load train_split.json and val_split.json, verify COCO format, check image/annotation counts, verify no overlap. Check GPU availability, VRAM, installed packages (ultralytics, torch, pycocotools, timm). Install ultralytics if needed.
plan.success_criteria: Splits validated, GPU confirmed, all packages available

plan.title: Build evaluation function and YOLO dataset conversion
plan.hypothesis: We need a reusable eval function and YOLO-format data before any training
plan.description: Implement eval function in utils.py: takes predictions + val_split.json, computes detection_mAP@0.5 (all cats→1), classification_mAP@0.5 (original cats), returns 0.7*det + 0.3*cls. Also convert train/val splits to YOLO format (txt labels + data.yaml) for 356 categories. Test eval with dummy predictions.
plan.success_criteria: Eval function returns valid scores, YOLO format files created and verified

plan.title: YOLOv8m baseline with nc=356 at imgsz=1280
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m at 1280 is a good balance of speed and accuracy for 356-class detection on dense shelf images
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m on train split with nc=356, imgsz=1280, epochs=150, batch=16 (adjust for VRAM). Use default augmentation. Evaluate with our eval function to get baseline val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Training completes, val_score > 0 establishing a baseline

plan.title: YOLOv8x with nc=356 at imgsz=1280
plan.hypothesis: Larger model improves both detection and classification on this dense dataset
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=356, imgsz=1280, epochs=200, batch=8, close_mosaic=30. Compare val_score to YOLOv8m baseline.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves over YOLOv8m baseline

plan.title: YOLOv8x with nc=1 (detection only) at imgsz=1280
plan.hypothesis: Single-class detector achieves higher recall since it only needs to find products, not classify them
plan.description: Convert annotations to single class. Train YOLOv8x with nc=1, imgsz=1280, epochs=200. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 only. This becomes the detection backbone for two-stage approach.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 exceeds the nc=356 model's detection mAP

plan.title: Tune NMS and confidence thresholds
plan.hypothesis: Dense shelves benefit from optimized NMS parameters, potentially gaining 1-3 mAP points
plan.description: Using best YOLO model, sweep conf_threshold [0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25] and iou_threshold [0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7]. Evaluate val_score for each combination.
plan.success_criteria: Find optimal thresholds that improve val_score over defaults

plan.title: Analyze product reference images for embedding classification
plan.hypothesis: Reference images coverage determines feasibility of two-stage approach
plan.description: Count products with reference images, check coverage of 356 categories, examine image quality. Cross-reference with annotation categories. Determine if enough categories have references for DINOv2-based classification.
plan.success_criteria: Understand reference image coverage and quality for classification pipeline

plan.title: Build DINOv2 embedding classification pipeline
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 embeddings can classify product crops via kNN against a gallery of reference + training crops
plan.description: Implement pipeline: (1) load DINOv2-base from torch hub, (2) extract embeddings from crops, (3) build gallery from reference images + training annotation crops, (4) classify via kNN. Test on a few val crops.
plan.success_criteria: Pipeline produces reasonable classifications on sample val crops

plan.title: Two-stage: nc=1 YOLO + DINOv2 kNN classification
plan.hypothesis: Two-stage approach achieves higher val_score than single-stage nc=356 YOLO
plan.description: Use nc=1 YOLO for detection, DINOv2-base kNN for classification. Evaluate full val_score (0.7*det + 0.3*cls). Compare to best nc=356 result.
plan.success_criteria: val_score exceeds best single-stage YOLO result

plan.title: Tune kNN and gallery composition
plan.hypothesis: Optimizing k, distance metric, and gallery composition improves classification mAP
plan.description: Sweep k=[1,3,5,7], distance=[cosine,L2], gallery variants (refs only, crops only, both, weighted). Evaluate classification_mAP@0.5.
plan.success_criteria: Find optimal kNN config that improves classification_mAP

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference for dense detection
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference on high-res images improves detection of small/dense products by 3-5 mAP
plan.description: Implement sliced inference: split images into overlapping tiles (1280x1280, stride ~960), run YOLO on each tile + full image, merge with WBF. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 and val_score.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improves over single-image inference

plan.title: TTA and multi-scale inference
plan.description: Run inference with augment=True on best YOLO model. Also test multi-scale [640, 1280, 1920] with WBF merge. Compare val_score to single-scale.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves with TTA or multi-scale

plan.title: Confidence-gated classification: YOLO vs DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO class when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain improves classification
plan.description: For each detection from nc=356 YOLO, use YOLO class if confidence > threshold, else use DINOv2 kNN. Sweep threshold on val split. This combines strengths of both approaches.
plan.success_criteria: Gated approach outperforms either pure YOLO or pure DINOv2 classification

plan.title: Spatial consistency post-processing
plan.hypothesis: Adjacent products on same shelf row are often identical; spatial consistency improves classification
plan.description: Group detections by shelf row (similar y-coords). Within each row, if adjacent detections have similar DINOv2 embeddings, assign same category via majority vote. Evaluate classification_mAP improvement.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improves with spatial consistency

plan.title: DINOv2-large vs DINOv2-base for classification
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-large produces better embeddings for fine-grained product classification
plan.description: Build gallery with DINOv2-large, evaluate classification_mAP@0.5. Compare to DINOv2-base. Check model size for 420MB budget.
plan.success_criteria: DINOv2-large improves classification_mAP enough to justify size increase

plan.title: Train fine-tuned projection head on DINOv2 features
plan.hypothesis: A learned projection head optimized for product similarity improves classification
plan.description: Freeze DINOv2, train 2-layer MLP with ArcFace/contrastive loss on training crops + reference images. Map 768-dim to 256-dim. Evaluate classification_mAP@0.5.
plan.success_criteria: Projection head improves classification_mAP over raw DINOv2 embeddings

plan.title: WBF ensemble: nc=356 + nc=1 YOLO detections
plan.hypothesis: Combining classification-aware and recall-maximizing detections improves overall val_score
plan.description: Merge nc=356 and nc=1 YOLO predictions with WBF. For nc=1 boxes, assign class via DINOv2. Sweep WBF parameters. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble val_score exceeds best single model

plan.title: Assemble and optimize final pipeline
plan.description: Build complete pipeline with best configuration: detection (best model/ensemble) + classification (best approach) + post-processing. Optimize for inference speed. Profile components.
plan.success_criteria: Pipeline runs end-to-end, achieves best val_score

plan.title: End-to-end validation and speed test
plan.hypothesis: Final pipeline achieves best val_score within inference time budget
plan.description: Run complete pipeline on val split. Verify val_score. Measure inference time, ensure < 300s for ~248 images. If over budget, identify and fix bottlenecks.
plan.success_criteria: Best val_score achieved, inference time within budget

plan.title: Package submission
plan.description: Export models to submission format (ONNX FP16 or .pt). Create final run.py with correct argument parsing and output format. Verify: ≤3 weight files, ≤420MB total, no blocked imports. Test end-to-end on val images.
plan.success_criteria: Submission package passes all constraints and produces correct output
